data.narrative:
Drafter is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Chris Barton and Peter Atkin. The company has raised $3M+ to date. The valuation benchmark set includes one public comparable (277810.KQ) and eight private peers in robotics and manufacturing, including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

A stage-progression methodology was applied, using the $3M total raised as a proxy baseline and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-Series A advancement. This yields an implied valuation of $8M. A peer-median approach was not applicable; while ten same-sector peers exist, the narrow filters (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier) did not yield sufficient datapoints (minimum three required) to establish a reliable median. Deploying an all-sector median would introduce excessive noise.

The single-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $6M to $9M, with a median of $8M. Key uncertainties include the absence of traction metrics (revenue, user counts, or deployment scale), which limits confidence in stage-progression assumptions, and insufficient comparable data at identical stage and scale. Any valuation within this range remains conditional on validation of underlying unit economics and market traction.
